title: 1.0 W01 to W03 Content Internal HTTP Binding
wireRule: W01 maps the public /api/v1/contents family to the exact internal operations below; Creator Center also uses the authenticated application route /api/creator/contents for owner-scoped reads; W03 never owns a public API namespace.

principal.source: W01 authoritative authentication result; never copied from public request body
principal.layerSource: W02 canonical L0-L8 resolution performed at W01 boundary; W03 uses it only for contracted creator/moderator transition gates

forwardedConventions: W01 forwards If-Match and Idempotency-Key exactly when the public operation requires them.
W01 does not forward end-user Authorization credentials to W03.
W03 treats missing/invalid caller or required principal headers as fail-closed transport/authentication failure.

failurePolicy.mutationRetryRule: Caller may retry only with the same Idempotency-Key where the public contract permits it.

security.trustBoundary: The binding is internal; W03 has no public route for these operations.
security.principalAuthority: W01 authenticates the caller using existing AUTH contracts and sends only the resolved user id.
security.payloadOwnership: ownerUserId is never accepted from public or internal caller payloads.
security.cache: W01 preserves the public cache rules; internal responses are no-store.
security.secrets: No end-user token or Payload secret is forwarded across the binding.
security.principalLayerAuthority: W01 sends the layer returned by the existing W02 authz resolution; W03 never infers layer from cache or from the public request

evidenceRequired: negative ownership and stale If-Match evidence
